RENT AGREEMENT

1. TERM
This agreement is for a period of eleven (11) months commencing on the first day of October and shall be registered as required.

2. SECURITY DEPOSIT
The Lessee shall pay a refundable security deposit equal to two (2) months rent. The deposit shall be refunded within one month of the Lessee vacating, less only the cost of damage beyond fair wear and tear, and the Lessor shall furnish an itemised account of any deduction.

3. RENT AND ESCALATION
The rent shall be increased by five percent (5%) at the end of every twelve months of the term.

4. NOTICE TO VACATE
Either party may end this agreement by giving two (2) months written notice to the other. The notice period is the same for both parties.

5. ENTRY
The Lessor may enter the premises for inspection or repairs after giving the Lessee at least twenty-four hours prior written notice, at a time convenient to the Lessee, except in an emergency.

6. REPAIRS
Structural repairs and repairs to the roof, walls and plumbing shall be carried out by the Lessor at the Lessor's cost. The Lessee shall be responsible only for damage caused by the Lessee.

7. TERMINATION
On the Lessee vacating, the Lessor shall refund the deposit as provided in clause 2. No part of the deposit shall be forfeited except against damage actually proved.
